title: The OlmoEarth Platform: Geospatial inference at planetary scale
excerpt: A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face

🌍 Learn more about OlmoEarth Platform: https://allenai.org/olmoearth

The OlmoEarth models are our family of Earth observation foundation models, pretrained on roughly 10 terabytes of multimodal satellite data. Governments, NGOs, and other mission-driven organizations are already adapting OlmoEarth for applications including deforestation monitoring, food security, and wildfire risk.

At Ai2, we know how to train and release powerful open models, and for organizations with strong engineering teams, an open model is all they need to run with. But most organizations in the environmental space – the ones best placed to apply these models – don't have the infrastructure or engineering teams that can manage the full lifecycle: labeling data, fine-tuning models, and running large-scale inference. We’ve spent more than a decade operating platforms like Skylight and EarthRanger, software that users around the world rely on every day, so it has to work every day. That experience taught us what delivering impact takes: running models cost-effectively at the right time and place, monitoring performance, turning raw outputs into actionable insights, and verifying those outputs drive the outcomes partners want.

That’s why we built the OlmoEarth Platform: infrastructure for taking geospatial models from fine-tuning and evaluation to large-scale inference.

Inference at this scale presents its own set of challenges. Satellite imagery must be found and accessed across multiple providers, aligned across projections and resolutions, and processed efficiently. Results then have to be stitched into geographically consistent maps while the infrastructure recovers from the routine failures of distributed computing.

Today, the platform can run inference across continent-scale areas in roughly a day, processing dozens of terabytes of imagery at a cost of fractions of a penny per square kilometer. Developing it meant confronting a series of engineering challenges that others working on large-scale geospatial systems are likely to encounter as well. This post walks through those challenges and the solutions we arrived at.

A recent wildfire risk map generated on the OlmoEarth Platform, with statistics.

Why satellite inference is challenging

Most ML models take in a few megabytes of data and produce a result in under a second—think LLMs processing a paragraph of text or computer vision models analyzing a photo from a smartphone. Earth observation inference operates at a very different scale—a single job fine-tuning a foundation model for maximum performance can move terabytes of data and run for hours. The inputs may span multiple spectral bands, sensor types, and time steps across a large geographic area. They can come from several providers, each using different projections and resolutions, and may include observations that are missing or obscured by clouds. The output is itself a map, so every prediction must remain precisely aligned with the same projection and coordinate grid as the areas around it.

Even acquiring the data can be a major challenge. Prediction jobs often spend more time downloading and preparing imagery than running the model itself, making efficient data pipelines critical. Those pipelines must handle high-volume I/O while providing the compute needed to reproject and resample imagery.

The right hardware for the right task

Because data acquisition and preparation often dominate an inference job’s runtime, assigning that work to GPUs would leave the system’s most expensive hardware doing tasks better suited to CPUs. We therefore divide each job into three stages, each matched to a distinct hardware profile:

  • Data acquisition and preprocessing (CPU, high I/O): Fetch, reproject, align, and normalize imagery, then write it in a format optimized for fast loading during inference.
  • Inference (GPU): Run the model’s forward pass and write minimally processed outputs directly to storage.
  • Postprocessing (CPU): Stitch the per-window outputs together, apply masks or rescaling, and export them in user-friendly formats such as Zarr, GeoTIFF, or GeoJSON.

The OlmoEarth Platform distributes these stages across many machines while keeping GPUs fully utilized. Multiprocess data loaders continuously feed each GPU, while completed outputs stream directly to blob storage.

One request, hundreds of workers, and thousands of processes

OlmoEarth Run, the platform’s execution layer for large-scale inference jobs, divides the geographic region covered by each job into partitions sized for individual compute instances (workers), then subdivides those partitions into smaller windows that the OlmoEarth models process. Because each window can be handled independently in a separate forward pass, work on one part of the map does not need to wait for another.

In practice, a state-sized area might become a hundred or so partitions, while a continent-scale run can become thousands. Adjacent partitions overlap slightly, and we reconcile that overlap when the outputs are assembled so no seam appears in the final raster.

Because the partitions are independent, the same stage can run across thousands of compute instances at once. We recently used this approach to generate a wildfire-risk map covering all of North America. At peak, the run used roughly 19,600 CPUs and 994 GPUs in parallel, with network throughput exceeding 168 GB/s. That level of parallelism reduced an estimated 4,737 hours of serial compute to about 30.5 hours of wall-clock time—a 155× speedup.

Fan-out is not unbounded, though. More workers push against cloud quotas, so parallelism is a per-run knob, one of several that we can adjust on individual jobs. Output resolution trades data volume and compute for detail; model size trades GPU time for accuracy; caching raw imagery trades storage for speed across repeated runs over the same area. The right setting depends on the task – and budget – at hand.

Finding and fetching the right pixels

Given a geographic region and time range, the platform first has to determine which satellite scenes should feed the model. That means identifying what was captured, where, and when across providers with different catalogs, formats, and publication delays. The selection criteria also depend on the source: for optical imagery such as Sentinel-2, we generally want the least-cloudy scenes available, while for synthetic aperture radar, the available polarization channels may matter more.

We rely on public STAC catalogs and open standards wherever possible. But a large inference job can generate thousands of metadata queries at once—far more than external services such as ESA’s or Microsoft Planetary Computer’s STAC APIs are designed to handle concurrently.

To avoid overwhelming those services, the OlmoEarth Platform maintains its own metadata index, updated as new imagery is published. For datasets hosted through AWS Open Data, we receive an SNS notification for each new scene. When a provider does not offer a change stream, we poll its upstream index every few minutes. As a result, our requests to external services follow the steady pace of new publications rather than the sudden burst generated by a large inference job.

Each index entry stores scene metadata along with pointers to every location where the underlying pixels are available. At runtime, the platform selects the best source and performs windowed reads against cloud-optimized formats such as COG or Zarr, retrieving only the bytes needed for a given partition rather than downloading entire scenes.

The index also supports our annotation tools. Because it maintains pointers to Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Landsat, and NISAR imagery in cloud-optimized formats, we can serve tiles from any indexed scene through the same windowed-read system, without building a separate ingestion pipeline.

The providers that made this workflow easiest shared three characteristics that we would recommend as best practices for publishing Earth observation data: queue-based notifications when new imagery becomes available, storage on major cloud platforms without bespoke rate limits or availability bottlenecks, and cloud-optimized formats that support ranged reads.

A sample query against the OlmoEarth satellite imagery index, searching for the least-cloudy Sentinel-2 image over San Francisco during the first week of June. The service returns the best available image along with a pointer to the GeoTIFF file in an Amazon S3 bucket.

Handling failure at scale

The OlmoEarth Platform is designed to recover from failures automatically. For each task within a stage and geographic partition, it dynamically provisions a virtual machine running our runner Docker container. The runner retrieves the task parameters, executes the work, returns the result, and shuts down. Because every task is reentrant and idempotent, intermittent failures can be handled safely by rerunning it.

At this scale, failures are expected: a provider may be slow or briefly unavailable; metadata may indicate that imagery exists even when a required band or window is missing; cloud cover may leave too few usable observations; or a task may crash outright. The platform responds with task tracking, automatic retries, fallback to alternate providers when available, and clear distinctions between retryable and fatal errors. A separate monitoring process detects runners that have stalled or stopped and restarts their tasks.

Where we're headed

Our roadmap is shaped by the gaps our partners have identified and the capabilities they need most. Among the areas we are working on:

  • Automated model runs. Schedule inference jobs in advance or trigger them whenever the imagery index registers a new scene over an area of interest.
  • Change detection and alerts. Notify users when the landscapes they monitor change, so events such as deforestation or flooding surface as alerts rather than rasters someone has to find and inspect manually.
  • Agentic tools and interfaces. Agents can lower the barrier to using geospatial models, from data curation and feature engineering to identifying ways to improve a fine-tuned model. We want users at any technical level to do work that previously required an experienced ML researcher.
  • Faster models. Work with our research team on more efficient architectures that reduce GPU time per window.
  • More modalities. Add new satellite sensors and data sources to both the OlmoEarth models and the imagery index that supports them. We’re currently focused on incorporating weather data (ERA-5) and satellites that provide more detail on environmental factors.
  • Embeddings. Develop a dedicated embedding model and precompute embeddings at global scale. For many tasks, running inference against those embeddings could replace a full forward pass over raw imagery, making workloads substantially faster and less expensive. Fine-tuning and direct inference will remain important for maximum performance on challenging tasks, but embeddings could open up a much broader range of efficient applications.
  • Run anywhere. OlmoEarth Run requires only virtual machines capable of running a Docker image and access to blob storage. We currently operate it on Google Cloud, but the architecture is designed to support multiple clouds and deployments within a partner’s own account and compute environment.

This is only the beginning. Geospatial foundation models, and especially operationalizing them, are still an emerging technology, and many of the organizations best positioned to use them – those working in conservation, food security, disaster response, and climate – have never had access to infrastructure like this. The gap between what these teams need to understand about the planet and what their budgets and technical resources allow them to do remains wide.

We are building OlmoEarth to help close it.

Those pipelines must handle high-volume I/O while providing the compute needed to reproject and resample imagery.

sentences.en: Even acquiring the data can be a major challenge.
sentences.zh: 即使获取数据也可能是一个重大挑战。

sentences.en: Prediction jobs often spend more time downloading and preparing imagery than running the model itself, making efficient data pipelines critical.
sentences.zh: 预测作业通常花费更多时间下载和准备图像而不是运行模型本身，这使得高效的数据管道变得至关重要。

sentences.en: Those pipelines must handle high-volume I/O while providing the compute needed to reproject and resample imagery.
sentences.zh: 这些管道必须处理大量 I/O，同时提供重新投影和重新采样图像所需的计算。

blocks.html_en: The right hardware for the right task

sentences.en: The right hardware for the right task
sentences.zh: 适合正确任务的正确硬件

blocks.html_en: Because data acquisition and preparation often dominate an inference job’s runtime, assigning that work to GPUs would leave the system’s most expensive hardware doing tasks better suited to CPUs. We therefore divide each job into three stages, each matched to a distinct hardware profile:

sentences.en: Because data acquisition and preparation often dominate an inference job’s runtime, assigning that work to GPUs would leave the system’s most expensive hardware doing tasks better suited to CPUs.
sentences.zh: 由于数据采集和准备通常主导推理作业的运行时间，因此将该工作分配给 GPU 将使系统最昂贵的硬件执行更适合 CPU 的任务。

sentences.en: We therefore divide each job into three stages, each matched to a distinct hardware profile:
sentences.zh: 因此，我们将每个作业分为三个阶段，每个阶段都与不同的硬件配置文件相匹配：

blocks.html_en: • Data acquisition and preprocessing (CPU, high I/O): Fetch, reproject, align, and normalize imagery, then write it in a format optimized for fast loading during inference.

sentences.en: Data acquisition and preprocessing (CPU, high I/O): Fetch, reproject, align, and normalize imagery, then write it in a format optimized for fast loading during inference.
sentences.zh: 数据采集​​和预处理（CPU、高 I/O）：获取、重新投影、对齐和标准化图像，然后以优化的格式写入以在推理过程中快速加载。

blocks.html_en: • Inference (GPU): Run the model’s forward pass and write minimally processed outputs directly to storage.

sentences.en: Inference (GPU): Run the model’s forward pass and write minimally processed outputs directly to storage.
sentences.zh: 推理 (GPU)：运行模型的前向传递并将经过最少处理的输出直接写入存储。

blocks.html_en: • Postprocessing (CPU): Stitch the per-window outputs together, apply masks or rescaling, and export them in user-friendly formats such as Zarr, GeoTIFF, or GeoJSON.

sentences.en: Postprocessing (CPU): Stitch the per-window outputs together, apply masks or rescaling, and export them in user-friendly formats such as Zarr, GeoTIFF, or GeoJSON.
sentences.zh: 后处理 (CPU)：将每个窗口的输出拼接在一起，应用遮罩或重新缩放，并以用户友好的格式（例如 Zarr、GeoTIFF 或 GeoJSON）导出它们。

blocks.html_en: The OlmoEarth Platform distributes these stages across many machines while keeping GPUs fully utilized. Multiprocess data loaders continuously feed each GPU, while completed outputs stream directly to blob storage.

sentences.en: The OlmoEarth Platform distributes these stages across many machines while keeping GPUs fully utilized.
sentences.zh: OlmoEarth 平台将这些阶段分布在许多机器上，同时保持 GPU 的充分利用。

sentences.en: Multiprocess data loaders continuously feed each GPU, while completed outputs stream directly to blob storage.
sentences.zh: 多进程数据加载器持续向每个 GPU 提供数据，同时完成的输出直接流到 blob 存储。

blocks.html_en: One request, hundreds of workers, and thousands of processes

sentences.en: One request, hundreds of workers, and thousands of processes
sentences.zh: 一个请求，数百个工作人员，数千个流程

blocks.html_en: OlmoEarth Run, the platform’s execution layer for large-scale inference jobs, divides the geographic region covered by each job into partitions sized for individual compute instances (workers), then subdivides those partitions into smaller windows that the OlmoEarth models process. Because each window can be handled independently in a separate forward pass, work on one part of the map does not need to wait for another.

sentences.en: OlmoEarth Run, the platform’s execution layer for large-scale inference jobs, divides the geographic region covered by each job into partitions sized for individual compute instances (workers), then subdivides those partitions into smaller windows that the OlmoEarth models process.
sentences.zh: OlmoEarth Run 是该平台用于大规模推理作业的执行层，它将每个作业覆盖的地理区域划分为适合各个计算实例（工作线程）大小的分区，然后将这些分区细分为 OlmoEarth 模型处理的较小窗口。

sentences.en: Because each window can be handled independently in a separate forward pass, work on one part of the map does not need to wait for another.
sentences.zh: 由于每个窗口都可以在单独的前向传递中独立处理，因此地图的一部分上的工作不需要等待另一部分。

blocks.html_en: In practice, a state-sized area might become a hundred or so partitions, while a continent-scale run can become thousands. Adjacent partitions overlap slightly, and we reconcile that overlap when the outputs are assembled so no seam appears in the final raster.

sentences.en: In practice, a state-sized area might become a hundred or so partitions, while a continent-scale run can become thousands.
sentences.zh: 实际上，一个州规模的区域可能会变成一百个左右的分区，而一个大陆规模的区域可能会变成数千个。

sentences.en: Adjacent partitions overlap slightly, and we reconcile that overlap when the outputs are assembled so no seam appears in the final raster.
sentences.zh: 相邻分区略有重叠，并且我们在组合输出时协调重叠，以便最终栅格中不会出现接缝。

blocks.html_en: Because the partitions are independent, the same stage can run across thousands of compute instances at once. We recently used this approach to generate a wildfire-risk map covering all of North America. At peak, the run used roughly 19,600 CPUs and 994 GPUs in parallel, with network throughput exceeding 168 GB/s. That level of parallelism reduced an estimated 4,737 hours of serial compute to about 30.5 hours of wall-clock time—a 155× speedup.

sentences.en: Because the partitions are independent, the same stage can run across thousands of compute instances at once.
sentences.zh: 由于分区是独立的，因此同一阶段可以同时运行数千个计算实例。

sentences.en: We recently used this approach to generate a wildfire-risk map covering all of North America.
sentences.zh: 我们最近使用这种方法生成了覆盖整个北美的野火风险地图。

sentences.en: At peak, the run used roughly 19,600 CPUs and 994 GPUs in parallel, with network throughput exceeding 168 GB/s.
sentences.zh: 在高峰期，该运行并行使用了大约 19,600 个 CPU 和 994 个 GPU，网络吞吐量超过 168 GB/s。

sentences.en: That level of parallelism reduced an estimated 4,737 hours of serial compute to about 30.5 hours of wall-clock time—a 155× speedup.
sentences.zh: 这种并行度将估计 4,737 小时的串行计算时间减少到约 30.5 小时的挂钟时间，加速了 155 倍。

blocks.html_en: Fan-out is not unbounded, though. More workers push against cloud quotas, so parallelism is a per-run knob, one of several that we can adjust on individual jobs. Output resolution trades data volume and compute for detail; model size trades GPU time for accuracy; caching raw imagery trades storage for speed across repeated runs over the same area. The right setting depends on the task – and budget – at hand.

sentences.en: Fan-out is not unbounded, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，扇出并不是无限制的。

sentences.en: More workers push against cloud quotas, so parallelism is a per-run knob, one of several that we can adjust on individual jobs.
sentences.zh: 更多的工作人员会推动云配额，因此并行性是每次运行的一个旋钮，是我们可以针对各个作业进行调整的几个旋钮之一。

sentences.en: Output resolution trades data volume and compute for detail; model size trades GPU time for accuracy; caching raw imagery trades storage for speed across repeated runs over the same area.
sentences.zh: 输出分辨率以数据量和计算换取细节；模型大小以 GPU 时间换取准确性；缓存原始图像会以存储空间换取在同一区域重复运行的速度。

sentences.en: The right setting depends on the task – and budget – at hand.
sentences.zh: 正确的设置取决于手头的任务和预算。

blocks.html_en: Finding and fetching the right pixels

sentences.en: Finding and fetching the right pixels
sentences.zh: 查找并获取正确的像素

blocks.html_en: Given a geographic region and time range, the platform first has to determine which satellite scenes should feed the model. That means identifying what was captured, where, and when across providers with different catalogs, formats, and publication delays. The selection criteria also depend on the source: for optical imagery such as Sentinel-2, we generally want the least-cloudy scenes available, while for synthetic aperture radar, the available polarization channels may matter more.

sentences.en: Given a geographic region and time range, the platform first has to determine which satellite scenes should feed the model.
sentences.zh: 给定地理区域和时间范围，平台首先必须确定哪些卫星场景应该为模型提供数据。

sentences.en: That means identifying what was captured, where, and when across providers with different catalogs, formats, and publication delays.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要确定不同目录、格式和发布延迟的提供商之间捕获的内容、地点和时间。

sentences.en: The selection criteria also depend on the source: for optical imagery such as Sentinel-2, we generally want the least-cloudy scenes available, while for synthetic aperture radar, the available polarization channels may matter more.
sentences.zh: 选择标准还取决于来源：对于 Sentinel-2 等光学图像，我们通常希望可用的云量最少的场景，而对于合成孔径雷达，可用的偏振通道可能更重要。

blocks.html_en: We rely on public STAC catalogs and open standards wherever possible. But a large inference job can generate thousands of metadata queries at once—far more than external services such as ESA’s or Microsoft Planetary Computer’s STAC APIs are designed to handle concurrently.

sentences.en: We rely on public STAC catalogs and open standards wherever possible.
sentences.zh: 我们尽可能依赖公共 STAC 目录和开放标准。

sentences.en: But a large inference job can generate thousands of metadata queries at once—far more than external services such as ESA’s or Microsoft Planetary Computer’s STAC APIs are designed to handle concurrently.
sentences.zh: 但大型推理作业可以同时生成数千个元数据查询，远远超过 ESA 或 Microsoft Planetary Computer 的 STAC API 等外部服务的设计并发处理量。

blocks.html_en: To avoid overwhelming those services, the OlmoEarth Platform maintains its own metadata index, updated as new imagery is published. For datasets hosted through AWS Open Data, we receive an SNS notification for each new scene. When a provider does not offer a change stream, we poll its upstream index every few minutes. As a result, our requests to external services follow the steady pace of new publications rather than the sudden burst generated by a large inference job.

sentences.en: To avoid overwhelming those services, the OlmoEarth Platform maintains its own metadata index, updated as new imagery is published.
sentences.zh: 为了避免这些服务不堪重负，OlmoEarth 平台维护自己的元数据索引，并随着新图像的发布而更新。

sentences.en: For datasets hosted through AWS Open Data, we receive an SNS notification for each new scene.
sentences.zh: 对于通过 AWS Open Data 托管的数据集，我们会收到每个新场景的 SNS 通知。

sentences.en: When a provider does not offer a change stream, we poll its upstream index every few minutes.
sentences.zh: 当提供商不提供变更流时，我们每隔几分钟轮询其上游索引。

sentences.en: As a result, our requests to external services follow the steady pace of new publications rather than the sudden burst generated by a large inference job.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们对外部服务的请求遵循新出版物的稳定节奏，而不是大型推理工作产生的突然爆发。

blocks.html_en: Each index entry stores scene metadata along with pointers to every location where the underlying pixels are available. At runtime, the platform selects the best source and performs windowed reads against cloud-optimized formats such as COG or Zarr, retrieving only the bytes needed for a given partition rather than downloading entire scenes.

sentences.en: Each index entry stores scene metadata along with pointers to every location where the underlying pixels are available.
sentences.zh: 每个索引条目存储场景元数据以及指向底层像素可用的每个位置的指针。

sentences.en: At runtime, the platform selects the best source and performs windowed reads against cloud-optimized formats such as COG or Zarr, retrieving only the bytes needed for a given partition rather than downloading entire scenes.
sentences.zh: 在运行时，该平台会选择最佳源并对云优化格式（例如 COG 或 Zarr）执行窗口读取，仅检索给定分区所需的字节，而不是下载整个场景。

blocks.html_en: The index also supports our annotation tools. Because it maintains pointers to Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Landsat, and NISAR imagery in cloud-optimized formats, we can serve tiles from any indexed scene through the same windowed-read system, without building a separate ingestion pipeline.

sentences.en: The index also supports our annotation tools.
sentences.zh: 该索引还支持我们的注释工具。

sentences.en: Because it maintains pointers to Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Landsat, and NISAR imagery in cloud-optimized formats, we can serve tiles from any indexed scene through the same windowed-read system, without building a separate ingestion pipeline.
sentences.zh: 由于它以云优化格式维护指向 Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2、Landsat 和 NISAR 图像的指针，因此我们可以通过同一窗口读取系统提供来自任何索引场景的图块，而无需构建单独的摄取管道。

blocks.html_en: The providers that made this workflow easiest shared three characteristics that we would recommend as best practices for publishing Earth observation data: queue-based notifications when new imagery becomes available, storage on major cloud platforms without bespoke rate limits or availability bottlenecks, and cloud-optimized formats that support ranged reads.

sentences.en: The providers that made this workflow easiest shared three characteristics that we would recommend as best practices for publishing Earth observation data: queue-based notifications when new imagery becomes available, storage on major cloud platforms without bespoke rate limits or availability bottlenecks, and cloud-optimized formats that support ranged reads.
sentences.zh: 使此工作流程变得最简单的提供商共享三个特征，我们建议将其作为发布地球观测数据的最佳实践：新图像可用时基于队列的通知、在主要云平台上存储而没有定制的速率限制或可用性瓶颈，以及支持远程读取的云优化格式。

blocks.html_en: A sample query against the OlmoEarth satellite imagery index, searching for the least-cloudy Sentinel-2 image over San Francisco during the first week of June. The service returns the best available image along with a pointer to the GeoTIFF file in an Amazon S3 bucket.

sentences.en: A sample query against the OlmoEarth satellite imagery index, searching for the least-cloudy Sentinel-2 image over San Francisco during the first week of June.
sentences.zh: 针对 OlmoEarth 卫星图像索引的示例查询，搜索 6 月第一周旧金山上空云量最少的 Sentinel-2 图像。

sentences.en: The service returns the best available image along with a pointer to the GeoTIFF file in an Amazon S3 bucket.
sentences.zh: 该服务返回最佳可用图像以及指向 Amazon S3 存储桶中 GeoTIFF 文件的指针。

blocks.html_en: Handling failure at scale

sentences.en: Handling failure at scale
sentences.zh: 处理大规模故障

blocks.html_en: The OlmoEarth Platform is designed to recover from failures automatically. For each task within a stage and geographic partition, it dynamically provisions a virtual machine running our runner Docker container. The runner retrieves the task parameters, executes the work, returns the result, and shuts down. Because every task is reentrant and idempotent, intermittent failures can be handled safely by rerunning it.

sentences.en: The OlmoEarth Platform is designed to recover from failures automatically.
sentences.zh: OlmoEarth 平台旨在自动从故障中恢复。

sentences.en: For each task within a stage and geographic partition, it dynamically provisions a virtual machine running our runner Docker container.
sentences.zh: 对于阶段和地理分区内的每个任务，它动态地配置运行我们的运行器 Docker 容器的虚拟机。

sentences.en: The runner retrieves the task parameters, executes the work, returns the result, and shuts down.
sentences.zh: 运行器检索任务参数，执行工作，返回结果，然后关闭。

sentences.en: Because every task is reentrant and idempotent, intermittent failures can be handled safely by rerunning it.
sentences.zh: 由于每个任务都是可重入且幂等的，因此可以通过重新运行任务来安全地处理间歇性故障。

blocks.html_en: At this scale, failures are expected: a provider may be slow or briefly unavailable; metadata may indicate that imagery exists even when a required band or window is missing; cloud cover may leave too few usable observations; or a task may crash outright. The platform responds with task tracking, automatic retries, fallback to alternate providers when available, and clear distinctions between retryable and fatal errors. A separate monitoring process detects runners that have stalled or stopped and restarts their tasks.

sentences.en: At this scale, failures are expected: a provider may be slow or briefly unavailable; metadata may indicate that imagery exists even when a required band or window is missing; cloud cover may leave too few usable observations; or a task may crash outright.
sentences.zh: 在这种规模下，出现故障是预料之中的：提供商可能会运行缓慢或短暂不可用；元数据可能表明，即使缺少所需的波段或窗口，图像也存在；云层覆盖可能留下太少的可用观测结果；否则任务可能会彻底崩溃。

sentences.en: The platform responds with task tracking, automatic retries, fallback to alternate providers when available, and clear distinctions between retryable and fatal errors.
sentences.zh: 该平台通过任务跟踪、自动重试、备用提供商（如果可用）的回退以及可重试错误和致命错误之间的明确区别来进行响应。

sentences.en: A separate monitoring process detects runners that have stalled or stopped and restarts their tasks.
sentences.zh: 单独的监控进程会检测已停止或停止的运行程序并重新启动其任务。

blocks.html_en: Where we're headed

sentences.en: Where we're headed
sentences.zh: 我们要去哪里

blocks.html_en: Our roadmap is shaped by the gaps our partners have identified and the capabilities they need most. Among the areas we are working on:

sentences.en: Our roadmap is shaped by the gaps our partners have identified and the capabilities they need most.
sentences.zh: 我们的路线图是根据我们的合作伙伴发现的差距和他们最需要的能力制定的。

sentences.en: Among the areas we are working on:
sentences.zh: 我们正在研究的领域包括：

blocks.html_en: • Automated model runs. Schedule inference jobs in advance or trigger them whenever the imagery index registers a new scene over an area of interest.

sentences.en: Automated model runs.
sentences.zh: 自动化模型运行。

sentences.en: Schedule inference jobs in advance or trigger them whenever the imagery index registers a new scene over an area of interest.
sentences.zh: 提前安排推理作业，或在图像索引在感兴趣区域上注册新场景时触发推理作业。

blocks.html_en: • Change detection and alerts. Notify users when the landscapes they monitor change, so events such as deforestation or flooding surface as alerts rather than rasters someone has to find and inspect manually.

sentences.en: Change detection and alerts.
sentences.zh: 变更检测和警报。

sentences.en: Notify users when the landscapes they monitor change, so events such as deforestation or flooding surface as alerts rather than rasters someone has to find and inspect manually.
sentences.zh: 当用户监测的景观发生变化时通知用户，因此森林砍伐或洪水泛滥等事件会作为警报，而不是需要手动查找和检查的栅格。

blocks.html_en: • Agentic tools and interfaces. Agents can lower the barrier to using geospatial models, from data curation and feature engineering to identifying ways to improve a fine-tuned model. We want users at any technical level to do work that previously required an experienced ML researcher.

sentences.en: Agentic tools and interfaces.
sentences.zh: 代理工具和界面。

sentences.en: Agents can lower the barrier to using geospatial models, from data curation and feature engineering to identifying ways to improve a fine-tuned model.
sentences.zh: 代理可以降低使用地理空间模型的障碍，从数据管理和特征工程到确定改进微调模型的方法。

sentences.en: We want users at any technical level to do work that previously required an experienced ML researcher.
sentences.zh: 我们希望任何技术级别的用户都能完成以前需要经验丰富的机器学习研究人员才能完成的工作。

blocks.html_en: • Faster models. Work with our research team on more efficient architectures that reduce GPU time per window.

sentences.en: Faster models.
sentences.zh: 更快的模型。

sentences.en: Work with our research team on more efficient architectures that reduce GPU time per window.
sentences.zh: 与我们的研究团队合作开发更高效的架构，减少每个窗口的 GPU 时间。

blocks.html_en: • More modalities. Add new satellite sensors and data sources to both the OlmoEarth models and the imagery index that supports them. We’re currently focused on incorporating weather data (ERA-5) and satellites that provide more detail on environmental factors.

sentences.en: More modalities.
sentences.zh: 更多方式。

sentences.en: Add new satellite sensors and data sources to both the OlmoEarth models and the imagery index that supports them.
sentences.zh: 将新的卫星传感器和数据源添加到 OlmoEarth 模型和支持它们的图像索引中。

sentences.en: We’re currently focused on incorporating weather data (ERA-5) and satellites that provide more detail on environmental factors.
sentences.zh: 我们目前专注于整合天气数据 (ERA-5) 和卫星，以提供有关环境因素的更多详细信息。

blocks.html_en: • Embeddings. Develop a dedicated embedding model and precompute embeddings at global scale. For many tasks, running inference against those embeddings could replace a full forward pass over raw imagery, making workloads substantially faster and less expensive. Fine-tuning and direct inference will remain important for maximum performance on challenging tasks, but embeddings could open up a much broader range of efficient applications.

sentences.en: Embeddings.
sentences.zh: 嵌入。

sentences.en: Develop a dedicated embedding model and precompute embeddings at global scale.
sentences.zh: 开发专用的嵌入模型并在全球范围内预计算嵌入。

sentences.en: For many tasks, running inference against those embeddings could replace a full forward pass over raw imagery, making workloads substantially faster and less expensive.
sentences.zh: 对于许多任务，针对这些嵌入运行推理可以取代对原始图像的完整前向传递，从而使工作负载更快、更便宜。

sentences.en: Fine-tuning and direct inference will remain important for maximum performance on challenging tasks, but embeddings could open up a much broader range of efficient applications.
sentences.zh: 微调和直接推理对于在具有挑战性的任务中获得最大性能仍然很重要，但嵌入可以开辟更广泛的高效应用程序。

blocks.html_en: • Run anywhere. OlmoEarth Run requires only virtual machines capable of running a Docker image and access to blob storage. We currently operate it on Google Cloud, but the architecture is designed to support multiple clouds and deployments within a partner’s own account and compute environment.

sentences.en: Run anywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处跑。

sentences.en: OlmoEarth Run requires only virtual machines capable of running a Docker image and access to blob storage.
sentences.zh: OlmoEarth Run 仅需要能够运行 Docker 映像并访问 blob 存储的虚拟机。

sentences.en: We currently operate it on Google Cloud, but the architecture is designed to support multiple clouds and deployments within a partner’s own account and compute environment.
sentences.zh: 我们目前在 Google Cloud 上运行它，但该架构旨在支持合作伙伴自己的帐户和计算环境中的多个云和部署。

blocks.html_en: This is only the beginning. Geospatial foundation models, and especially operationalizing them, are still an emerging technology, and many of the organizations best positioned to use them – those working in conservation, food security, disaster response, and climate – have never had access to infrastructure like this. The gap between what these teams need to understand about the planet and what their budgets and technical resources allow them to do remains wide.

sentences.en: This is only the beginning.
sentences.zh: 这只是开始。

sentences.en: Geospatial foundation models, and especially operationalizing them, are still an emerging technology, and many of the organizations best positioned to use them – those working in conservation, food security, disaster response, and climate – have never had access to infrastructure like this.
sentences.zh: 地理空间基础模型，尤其是其可操作性，仍然是一项新兴技术，许多最适合使用它们的组织——那些从事保护、粮食安全、灾害响应和气候工作的组织——从未获得过这样的基础设施。

sentences.en: The gap between what these teams need to understand about the planet and what their budgets and technical resources allow them to do remains wide.
sentences.zh: 这些团队需要了解的地球知识与他们的预算和技术资源允许他们做的事情之间的差距仍然很大。

blocks.html_en: We are building OlmoEarth to help close it.

sentences.en: We are building OlmoEarth to help close it.

🌍 了解有关 OlmoEarth 平台的更多信息：https://allenai.org/olmoearth

OlmoEarth 模型是我们的地球观测基础模型系列，在大约 10 TB 的多模式卫星数据上进行了预训练。 政府、非政府组织和其他任务驱动的组织已经在将 OlmoEarth 应用于森林砍伐监测、粮食安全和野火风险等应用。

在 Ai2，我们知道如何训练和发布强大的开放模型，对于拥有强大工程团队的组织来说，开放模型就是他们运行所需的全部。 但环境领域的大多数组织（最适合应用这些模型的组织）没有可以管理整个生命周期的基础设施或工程团队：标记数据、微调模型和运行大规模推理。 我们花了十多年的时间来运营 Skylight 和 EarthRanger 等平台，这些软件是世界各地用户每天依赖的软件，因此它必须每天都能工作。 这一经验告诉我们如何发挥影响力：在正确的时间和地点经济有效地运行模型、监控绩效、将原始输出转化为可操作的见解，并验证这些输出是否能实现合作伙伴想要的结果。

这就是我们构建 OlmoEarth 平台的原因：用于将地理空间模型从微调和评估到大规模推理的基础设施。

这种规模的推理也面临着一系列挑战。 必须跨多个提供商查找和访问卫星图像，跨投影和分辨率进行调整，并进行有效处理。 然后，必须将结果拼接成地理上一致的地图，同时基础设施从分布式计算的常规故障中恢复。

如今，该平台可以在大约一天内对大陆范围的区域进行推理，以每平方公里几美分的成本处理数十 TB 的图像。 开发它意味着面临一系列工程挑战，其他从事大规模地理空间系统工作的人也可能会遇到这些挑战。 这篇文章将介绍这些挑战以及我们达成的解决方案。

OlmoEarth 平台上最近生成的野火风险地图，并附有统计数据。

为什么卫星推理具有挑战性

大多数机器学习模型都会接收几兆字节的数据，并在不到一秒的时间内产生结果——想想法学硕士处理一段文本或分析智能手机照片的计算机视觉模型。 地球观测推理的运行规模非常不同——对基础模型进行微调以获得最佳性能的单个作业可以移动数 TB 的数据并运行数小时。 输入可能跨越较大地理区域的多个光谱带、传感器类型和时间步长。 它们可能来自多个提供者，每个提供者使用不同的投影和分辨率，并且可能包括丢失或被云遮盖的观测结果。 输出本身就是一张地图，因此每个预测都必须与其周围区域的相同投影和坐标网格保持精确对齐。

即使获取数据也可能是一个重大挑战。 预测作业通常花费更多时间下载和准备图像而不是运行模型本身，这使得高效的数据管道变得至关重要。 这些管道必须处理大量 I/O，同时提供重新投影和重新采样图像所需的计算。

适合正确任务的正确硬件

由于数据采集和准备通常主导推理作业的运行时间，因此将该工作分配给 GPU 将使系统最昂贵的硬件执行更适合 CPU 的任务。 因此，我们将每个作业分为三个阶段，每个阶段都与不同的硬件配置文件相匹配：

  • 数据采集​​和预处理（CPU、高 I/O）：获取、重新投影、对齐和标准化图像，然后以优化的格式写入以在推理过程中快速加载。
  • 推理 (GPU)：运行模型的前向传递并将经过最少处理的输出直接写入存储。
  • 后处理 (CPU)：将每个窗口的输出拼接在一起，应用遮罩或重新缩放，并以用户友好的格式（例如 Zarr、GeoTIFF 或 GeoJSON）导出它们。

OlmoEarth 平台将这些阶段分布在许多机器上，同时保持 GPU 的充分利用。 多进程数据加载器持续向每个 GPU 提供数据，同时完成的输出直接流到 blob 存储。

一个请求，数百个工作人员，数千个流程

OlmoEarth Run 是该平台用于大规模推理作业的执行层，它将每个作业覆盖的地理区域划分为适合各个计算实例（工作线程）大小的分区，然后将这些分区细分为 OlmoEarth 模型处理的较小窗口。 由于每个窗口都可以在单独的前向传递中独立处理，因此地图的一部分上的工作不需要等待另一部分。

实际上，一个州规模的区域可能会变成一百个左右的分区，而一个大陆规模的区域可能会变成数千个。 相邻分区略有重叠，并且我们在组合输出时协调重叠，以便最终栅格中不会出现接缝。

由于分区是独立的，因此同一阶段可以同时运行数千个计算实例。 我们最近使用这种方法生成了覆盖整个北美的野火风险地图。 在高峰期，该运行并行使用了大约 19,600 个 CPU 和 994 个 GPU，网络吞吐量超过 168 GB/s。 这种并行度将估计 4,737 小时的串行计算时间减少到约 30.5 小时的挂钟时间，加速了 155 倍。

不过，扇出并不是无限制的。 更多的工作人员会推动云配额，因此并行性是每次运行的一个旋钮，是我们可以针对各个作业进行调整的几个旋钮之一。 输出分辨率以数据量和计算换取细节；模型大小以 GPU 时间换取准确性；缓存原始图像会以存储空间换取在同一区域重复运行的速度。 正确的设置取决于手头的任务和预算。

查找并获取正确的像素

给定地理区域和时间范围，平台首先必须确定哪些卫星场景应该为模型提供数据。 这意味着要确定不同目录、格式和发布延迟的提供商之间捕获的内容、地点和时间。 选择标准还取决于来源：对于 Sentinel-2 等光学图像，我们通常希望可用的云量最少的场景，而对于合成孔径雷达，可用的偏振通道可能更重要。

我们尽可能依赖公共 STAC 目录和开放标准。 但大型推理作业可以同时生成数千个元数据查询，远远超过 ESA 或 Microsoft Planetary Computer 的 STAC API 等外部服务的设计并发处理量。

为了避免这些服务不堪重负，OlmoEarth 平台维护自己的元数据索引，并随着新图像的发布而更新。 对于通过 AWS Open Data 托管的数据集，我们会收到每个新场景的 SNS 通知。 当提供商不提供变更流时，我们每隔几分钟轮询其上游索引。 因此，我们对外部服务的请求遵循新出版物的稳定节奏，而不是大型推理工作产生的突然爆发。

每个索引条目存储场景元数据以及指向底层像素可用的每个位置的指针。 在运行时，该平台会选择最佳源并对云优化格式（例如 COG 或 Zarr）执行窗口读取，仅检索给定分区所需的字节，而不是下载整个场景。

该索引还支持我们的注释工具。 由于它以云优化格式维护指向 Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2、Landsat 和 NISAR 图像的指针，因此我们可以通过同一窗口读取系统提供来自任何索引场景的图块，而无需构建单独的摄取管道。

使此工作流程变得最简单的提供商共享三个特征，我们建议将其作为发布地球观测数据的最佳实践：新图像可用时基于队列的通知、在主要云平台上存储而没有定制的速率限制或可用性瓶颈，以及支持远程读取的云优化格式。

针对 OlmoEarth 卫星图像索引的示例查询，搜索 6 月第一周旧金山上空云量最少的 Sentinel-2 图像。 该服务返回最佳可用图像以及指向 Amazon S3 存储桶中 GeoTIFF 文件的指针。

处理大规模故障

OlmoEarth 平台旨在自动从故障中恢复。 对于阶段和地理分区内的每个任务，它动态地配置运行我们的运行器 Docker 容器的虚拟机。 运行器检索任务参数，执行工作，返回结果，然后关闭。 由于每个任务都是可重入且幂等的，因此可以通过重新运行任务来安全地处理间歇性故障。

在这种规模下，出现故障是预料之中的：提供商可能会运行缓慢或短暂不可用；元数据可能表明，即使缺少所需的波段或窗口，图像也存在；云层覆盖可能留下太少的可用观测结果；否则任务可能会彻底崩溃。 该平台通过任务跟踪、自动重试、备用提供商（如果可用）的回退以及可重试错误和致命错误之间的明确区别来进行响应。 单独的监控进程会检测已停止或停止的运行程序并重新启动其任务。

我们要去哪里

我们的路线图是根据我们的合作伙伴发现的差距和他们最需要的能力制定的。 我们正在研究的领域包括：

  • 自动化模型运行。 提前安排推理作业，或在图像索引在感兴趣区域上注册新场景时触发推理作业。
  • 变更检测和警报。 当用户监测的景观发生变化时通知用户，因此森林砍伐或洪水泛滥等事件会作为警报，而不是需要手动查找和检查的栅格。
  • 代理工具和界面。 代理可以降低使用地理空间模型的障碍，从数据管理和特征工程到确定改进微调模型的方法。 我们希望任何技术级别的用户都能完成以前需要经验丰富的机器学习研究人员才能完成的工作。
  • 更快的模型。 与我们的研究团队合作开发更高效的架构，减少每个窗口的 GPU 时间。
  • 更多方式。 将新的卫星传感器和数据源添加到 OlmoEarth 模型和支持它们的图像索引中。 我们目前专注于整合天气数据 (ERA-5) 和卫星，以提供有关环境因素的更多详细信息。
  • 嵌入。 开发专用的嵌入模型并在全球范围内预计算嵌入。 对于许多任务，针对这些嵌入运行推理可以取代对原始图像的完整前向传递，从而使工作负载更快、更便宜。 微调和直接推理对于在具有挑战性的任务中获得最大性能仍然很重要，但嵌入可以开辟更广泛的高效应用程序。
  • 到处跑。 OlmoEarth Run 仅需要能够运行 Docker 映像并访问 blob 存储的虚拟机。 我们目前在 Google Cloud 上运行它，但该架构旨在支持合作伙伴自己的帐户和计算环境中的多个云和部署。

这只是开始。 地理空间基础模型，尤其是其可操作性，仍然是一项新兴技术，许多最适合使用它们的组织——那些从事保护、粮食安全、灾害响应和气候工作的组织——从未获得过这样的基础设施。 这些团队需要了解的地球知识与他们的预算和技术资源允许他们做的事情之间的差距仍然很大。

我们正在构建 OlmoEarth 来帮助关闭它。
